product_one_liner.value: SiMa.ai combines purpose-built chips and development software to let robotics, automotive, drone, industrial, and other edge-device developers build and run power-efficient AI directly on devices.

pricing_page.notes: No public pricing link appears on the homepage; the pricing URL yielded no readable page.

named_customers.notes: These organizations are explicitly described as customers in the cited report, rather than inferred from the mixed customer/partner logo wall.

eng_blog.notes: Technical posts by VP Hardware Engineering Srivi Dhruvanarayan and Associate VP MLA Software Ashok Sudarsanam describe Modalix architecture and the LLiMa compilation framework.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: Principal Engineer, AI & ML Design Verification (AI2517), posted June 26, 2026, remains listed on the current role index. Current listings were checked November 10, 2026; a November 9 archived snapshot was not available.

model_provider.value: Meta Llama 3.2, sourced through Hugging Face
model_provider.notes: The documentation demonstrates compiling meta-llama/Llama-3.2-3B for local inference; this is supported on-device model execution, not a claim of a hosted model API dependency.

compliance_certs.notes: The privacy policy names none of SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, GDPR, or PCI DSS as company certifications.
